meta.title: Codex threads
meta.description: Start or continue a Codex session from DeepSeek Harness without idling. codex_thread_new opens a session in a directory and returns its id; codex_thread_read accepts that id, an existing one, a codex://threads/<id> link, or a rollout path, and returns the working directory, the model, whether Codex is running the session right now, and recent messages. codex_thread_send continues the same session instead of forking it and returns while Codex is still working, so the caller does its own share of the task and collects later; delivery is a new session through `codex exec`, an owned turn through `codex exec resume` when the session is idle, or `codex queue` when the Codex app holds the session's writer lock. codex_thread_review sends the merged result back for an independent review, and codex_thread_wait collects progress with a short window instead of one long block. Reads the local store under $CODEX_HOME (default ~/.codex); it moves no Codex data anywhere else and needs no login of its own. Turning it off removes the seven tools and the Codex sessions hint; Codex sessions themselves are untouched.
